data.one_liner: Code generation tooling for Dart Frog backend applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides code generation tooling for Dart Frog, a fast and minimalistic backend framework for Dart. It allows developers to build route configurations from directories.
use_when: You are building a backend application using the Dart Frog framework.
You need to automatically build and manage route configurations for your project.
avoid_when: You are not using the Dart Frog framework.
You are building a standard Flutter frontend application.
strengths: Automates route configuration building for Dart Frog.
Integrates seamlessly with the Dart Frog backend ecosystem.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Dart Frog framework and has little use outside of it.
data.setup_notes: Add to dependencies and use via Dart code or the Dart Frog CLI.
